name: Cantor
description: The Cantor set: the middle third taken out, and taken out again from what is left.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 33.4%, transparent 33.4% 66.7%, #000 66.7% 100%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11.2%, transparent 11.2% 22.3%, #000 22.3% 33.4%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 33.4%, transparent 33.4% 66.7%, #000 66.7% 100%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11.2%, transparent 11.2% 22.3%, #000 22.3% 33.4%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
